attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Maryland corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.md_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.md_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maryland state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MD requires addback of federal interest, IRC 199A, bonus depreciation. MD allows MD municipal bond interest subtraction.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maryland state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.md_state_additions = 0.0; if result.md_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.md_state_additions = result.md_state_additions + result.md_us_interest_income; endif set result.md_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.md_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.md_state_subtractions = result.md_state_subtractions + result.md_municipal_interest; endif add (("Maryland additions: $" + string value of (result.md_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.md_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.md_state_additions xdef { result.md_state_additions result.md_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.md_state_additions xdef } {} result.md_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.md_state_subtractions xdef { result.md_state_subtractions result.md_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.md_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.md_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Maryland additions: $" result.md_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.md_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maryland corporate income tax. Applies Maryland flat rate (8.25%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.md_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maryland corporate tax (flat rate 8.25%); Apply Maryland 8.25% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.md_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.md_apportioned_income + result.md_state_additions - result.md_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.md_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.md_taxable_income * result.md_corp_tax_rate - result.md_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.md_refund_or_owed = result.md_estimated_payments - result.md_tax_liability; add "Maryland taxable income: $" + string value of (result.md_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Maryland tax liability (8.25%): $" + string value of (result.md_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.md_apportioned_income result.md_state_additions f+ result.md_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.md_taxable_income xdef result.md_taxable_income result.md_corp_tax_rate fmul result.md_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.md_tax_liability xdef result.md_estimated_payments result.md_tax_liability f- cvd /result.md_refund_or_owed xdef "Maryland taxable income: $" result.md_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Maryland tax liability (8.25%): $" result.md_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
